results.description:
Caring for someone you love should never feel lonely.

When someone you love needs more support, the family around them is often far apart. Different towns. Different schedules. The quiet worry of not being there. WarmNote gives your family one warm, private place to stay close, so no one carries it alone.

For the person at the heart of it all
Their screen is calm and simple. Big buttons. Kind words. One gentle thing at a time. With a single tap they can share how they are feeling today. Or they can just speak, and WarmNote writes it down for them. No typing. No fuss. Just their voice, heard.

For the family who cannot always be there
You see the small moments as they happen. A photo from this morning. A note that lunch went down well. How mum slept last night. The little things that tell you she is okay, even from far away.

So nothing is ever missed
Medicines, appointments and doctor visits all live in one place. Everyone can see what has been done and what is coming up. That quiet worry of "did someone remember?" finally settles.

Safe, and only for your family
Your circle is invite only. What you share stays between the people you trust. Your information is never sold and never used for advertising. Carers see only what they need to help, and your family's private notes stay in the family.

Care feels lighter when you carry it together.
That is what WarmNote is for.

WarmNote is free for a circle of up to 2 people.
Family plan: up to 6 members.
Extended plan: up to 15 members.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. You can manage or cancel anytime in your store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://carecircle.keystonedynamicsgroup.co.uk/privacy
Terms of Service: https://carecircle.keystonedynamicsgroup.co.uk/terms

results.description:
Caregiving involves more than showing up. It means remembering medications, preparing for doctor visits, following up on decisions, tracking changes and keeping family members informed.

Carevation brings the moving pieces of care into one shared place, helping families support an aging parent or other loved one with greater clarity.
Keep everyday care visible.

See upcoming tasks, medications and visits in one place, so you can quickly understand what needs attention.
Make every doctor’s visit count.

Prepare questions before an appointment, take notes or record the conversation with permission, and use Carevation’s Smart features to turn the visit into a clear summary and proposed next steps.

Stay on track with medications.
Maintain an up-to-date medication list, schedule reminders and record whether medications were taken.

Notice changes over time.
Track symptoms, severity and possible triggers so you have a clearer record when speaking with healthcare professionals.

Coordinate with your family.
Assign tasks, share updates and keep care information accessible to the people helping support your loved one.

Keep important information together.
Store care records, provider details, medical history and important files where you can find them when they are needed.

Carevation is designed for family caregivers, including adult children supporting an aging parent, long-distance caregivers and families sharing responsibility across several people.
Key features include:
- Caregiving tasks and assignments
- Doctor-visit preparation and notes
- Smart visit summaries and proposed follow-ups
- Medication lists, reminders and intake tracking
- Symptom tracking and health trends
- Shared family updates
- Care records, files and provider details
- Caregiver check-ins and journaling

Carevation supports care organization and communication. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional when making medical decisions.

Some features require a Carevation Premium or Pro subscription. Eligible new subscribers may receive a one-month free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your App Store account before the renewal date.

results.description:
Caring Village is the all-in-one app for family caregivers. Coordinate medications, schedules, tasks, and documents — and keep your whole care circle in the loop — without the chaos of texts, spreadsheets, and missed calls. Whether you're managing an aging parent's care from across the country or coordinating with siblings across town, Caring Village keeps everyone on the same page.

Why Caring Village?

Caregiving is rarely one person's job — but it often ends up that way. Multiple schedules, medications to track, documents to find, decisions to make together. Caring Village brings it all into one secure, family-focused platform so you can spend less time managing logistics and more time being present.

Key Features:

Julia – Your AI Caregiving Assistant
Meet Julia, your AI-powered caregiving assistant. Available anytime, Julia answers questions, offers guidance, and helps families make more informed decisions throughout the caregiving journey.

Advanced Medication Management
Set detailed medication reminders, track adherence, and share updates with your care circle. No more wondering if a dose was taken.

Shared Care Calendar
Keep everyone aligned with a shared calendar that syncs with external calendars so appointments don't slip through the cracks.

Printable Care Calendar
Export and print calendars for offline use or to share with doctors and family members.

Task Lists
Create and assign tasks to care circle members. Family members can volunteer for responsibilities — so caregiving is shared, not shouldered alone.

Expert-Curated Checklists
Access checklists built by caregiving experts to guide you through complex situations, from daily routines to emergency planning.

Customizable Care Plans
Design care plans tailored to your loved one's specific needs, with flexible reminders to stay on track.

Wellness Journal
Track moods, symptoms, and milestones. Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected — even from a distance.

Secure Document Storage
Store and organize medical records, insurance forms, and legal documents in one secure hub. Everything in one place when you need it most.

Built for Families Who Share the Load

Caregiving doesn't have to fall on one person. Caring Village makes it easy for your whole family to step in — volunteer for tasks, track medications, read updates — so the load is shared and nothing gets missed. Whether your family lives under one roof or across time zones, you'll have the tools to stay aligned, divide responsibilities, and show up for each other.

Who Is Caring Village For?


Family caregivers supporting aging parents
Spouses and partners managing chronic conditions
Families coordinating care across multiple households
Anyone who wants to get organized and share the caregiving load


Over 85,000 families use Caring Village to coordinate care and keep everyone in it.

Download today and see what organized caregiving looks like.

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the carers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a painkiller, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance details with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 carer. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count towards that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Terms of Use: https://circlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

results.description:
You didn't plan to become a carer. You just loved someone.

Now you're the one holding the appointment letter, the medication list, and the group chat nobody answers.

You're the one calling to check whether anyone visited. The one who knows what three different people promised to do this week.

There are days it feels like too much. Days when you wish someone else would step up, even for an hour. That feeling is not a failure. It's what happens when one person carries more than one person should.

The hardest part is not the doing. It is the knowing: being the one who always holds the full picture, because it lives only in your head.

KinCarer puts that picture somewhere the whole care circle can see it.

One shared schedule for tasks, visits and appointments. Check-ins so everyone knows someone arrived, without anyone having to phone. A chat beside the schedule, where any message can become a task in two taps. Routines and medication notes, so whoever visits next knows what's needed. Care Files for the documents that matter, somewhere the whole circle can find them.

When the picture is shared, the load is shared. Not just the doing, but the knowing.

WHO KINCARER IS FOR
Families looking after an elderly parent.
Brothers and sisters sharing the care from different towns.
Partners caring for someone with dementia or a long-term condition.
Families caring alongside paid carers or a care agency.
Anyone who has become the one who holds the full picture.

SHARED SCHEDULE
Add tasks, visits, appointments and reminders so everyone in the care circle can see what needs doing, who is doing it, and what has already happened.

CHECK-INS
Let the care circle know when someone has arrived at the care location. Turn on automatic check-ins and it takes one tap when a phone notices the arrival. KinCarer does not show live movement.

CIRCLE CHAT
Family and carers talk beside the schedule, not in another app. Anything decided in the chat can become a task or appointment in two taps, so nothing important gets buried.

ROUTINES AND MEDICATION
Keep daily routines, medication notes and care preferences together, so the next person helping knows what's needed.

HANDOVER NOTES
Leave an update after visits, appointments or changes so everyone stays in the loop without repeating the same messages.

CARE FILES
Store GP letters, care plans, photos and other documents in one place, so your care circle can find what matters when they need it.

CLARA AI ASSISTANT
Ask Clara what happened today, who checked in, or what is still waiting for someone. Clara answers only from what your circle has written down. Clara is optional and does not give medical advice.

CARE CIRCLE
Invite family members, friends, neighbours or paid carers. Roles and permissions help make sure people see the right information for how they are helping.

ONE SUBSCRIPTION FOR THE WHOLE CIRCLE
Family+ is one plan for the whole care circle, paid monthly or yearly, with 14 days free on the yearly plan. One subscription covers everyone: there is no member limit, and everyone you invite joins free. If Family+ ends, the circle becomes read-only until someone renews. Nothing is deleted.

KinCarer does not replace the love, judgement or care you already give. It helps you organise it, share it and feel less alone carrying it.

Download KinCarer and share the load.

Important: KinCarer is a family care coordination and planning app. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency response, safeguarding services or professional care services. Clara AI provides organisational support only and should not replace advice from qualified professionals.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store settings.

Create a care circle for your mother, father, grandma or grandpa and invite the family. Everyone sees the same: what happens today, what still needs doing and how things are going.

NEED A HAND? ASK YOUR FAMILY

STAY CLOSE, EVEN FROM FAR AWAY

ALL CARE DETAILS IN ONE PLACE
The care file with contacts, appointments, medical details and documents. Plus short courses (in Dutch) about caring for a loved one and an assistant that thinks along.

SAFE AND PRIVATE
Only the people you invite see your care circle.

FREE TO START
Start free with one care circle and two members. More family members or more care circles? Choose Family Pro: unlimited, with a 14-day free trial first.

FOR CARE PROFESSIONALS
Does your home care organisation use Nedap Ons? Then care professionals can use CareWall too, for their route, clients and reports.

Created by caregivers, Brelti brings your entire care team, important information, and daily tasks into a single, organized system—making care easier to coordinate and easier to sustain.

With Brelti, you can:
• Organize medical, legal, financial, and personal documents in one secure vault
• Coordinate care across family members and caregivers with shared access
• Track medications, conditions, allergies, and appointments
• Record and transcribe phone calls and conversations for future reference
• Discover and manage providers, including doctors, specialists, and services
• Stay on top of daily check-ins, reminders, and care updates

AI-POWERED ASSISTANCE, BUILT FOR REAL CARE
Brelti includes Bella, an AI-powered care assistant that helps you handle routine coordination tasks using natural language. You can ask Bella to:
• Schedule appointments and create calendar events
• Find nearby providers and store their information
• Upload and organize documents
• Manage medications and care notes
• Search across your stored medical records and files

Bella is designed to support organization and coordination—not to provide medical advice or diagnoses.

A VAULT THAT GOES BEYOND MEDICAL RECORDS
Unlike simple “medical binder” apps, Brelti’s vault is built for the full reality of caregiving. You can store and organize documents across multiple categories, including medical records, insurance, legal paperwork, financial documents, housing information, identity documents, notes, and recordings—all in one place.

BUILT FOR TEAMS, NOT JUST INDIVIDUALS
Care rarely falls on one person alone. Brelti lets you invite family members and caregivers, switch between care recipients, and keep everyone aligned without relying on scattered texts, emails, or notes apps.

DESIGNED WITH ACCESSIBILITY AND TRUST IN MIND
Brelti is built to be accessible and easy to use, with support for assistive technologies and clear, readable interfaces. Information entered into the app is provided by users and managed according to our privacy practices.

ianacare is for family caregivers: anyone caring for a parent, spouse, child, or other loved one living with a chronic or serious illness, including dementia.

Caring for someone you love isn't the problem — it's figuring out the unknowns. ianacare helps you get answers, make a plan, and keep track of it all, with real human support behind every step for eligible programs.

Anyone can access iana, Action Plans, the care log, and family coordination, on your phone or computer. If ianacare comes through your employer or the Medicare GUIDE program, you may also have a Care Navigator and additional resources (see below).

CHAT WITH IANA™, YOUR AI CARE COMPANION
Caregiving doesn't have office hours. Ask iana about managing care around a new diagnosis, a difficult behavior, or what to ask the doctor tomorrow, and iana can help you think it through. iana is built on ianacare's I Am Not Alone Care Model, shaped by 50,000+ family journeys, and remembers your situation so you don't have to start over.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Answer a few questions about where things stand today, and iana builds your Action Plan: a personalized, prioritized list of next steps with vetted resources and support options. It updates as your situation changes, so it's never a generic checklist.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DAY-TO-DAY
Quick Log captures care notes in a few taps — in the waiting room, the parking lot, or the kitchen at 6 a.m. Care Log History keeps every note and iana chat in one searchable place, and iana can summarize it before an appointment so you walk in prepared.

BRING IN FAMILY & FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT TO
Caring on your own? Everything above works for you. If others want to help, invite them to coordinate meals, rides, and tasks without the group text.

THROUGH YOUR EMPLOYER
If ianacare is a benefit at your work, you also get a Care Navigator, a trained caregiving expert you can message or schedule a call with. You'll also find benefits your employer offers, live events and support groups, and practical articles on the Community Hub. 

THROUGH THE MEDICARE GUIDE PROGRAM
The Medicare GUIDE program supports people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. If ianacare is your GUIDE provider, you may also have a dedicated Care Navigator, dementia-specific support, help arranging rest breaks (respite care), live events and support groups, and the Community Hub. If your Care Navigator is through another GUIDE provider, ianacare adds iana, tailored resources, and live events alongside that support. 

PRIVATE AND SECURE
ianacare follows HIPAA standards to protect your health information, and your data is encrypted to keep it safe. Your information is never sold or used for advertising, and you choose who on your team can see it.

IMPORTANT
iana is an AI, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Always talk with your care team about medical decisions. In a medical emergency, call 911. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

Terms of Use: https://ianacare.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://ianacare.com/privacy-policy/

Review recent routes and visited places when you need context. If a parent gets lost or cannot explain where they went, location history can help the family retrace the day.

results.description:
The shared carer app for families looking after an aging parent or loved one. Medications, doctor visits, tasks and updates — in one private place everyone can see.

Most families run care out of a group chat. Who picked up the prescription? Was the evening dose taken? What did the cardiologist say? Care Nest answers all of it.

MEDICATION TRACKER & PILL REMINDERS
Snap a photo of a pill bottle or prescription and Care Nest reads the name, dose and schedule for you. Dose reminders on your phone, refill alerts before you run out, and 7-day adherence at a glance. Everyone sees what was taken — and what was missed.

SHARE THE LOAD
A shared task board where pharmacy runs, rides to appointments and home repairs get claimed, not forgotten. Assign them, or leave them up for grabs.

KEEP EVERY DOCTOR VISIT STRAIGHT
Track appointments, who's driving and what to ask. Visit notes stay with the appointment so the whole family can read them afterwards.

A FAMILY JOURNAL, NOT A GROUP CHAT
Short updates with mood tags so nobody has to ask "how are they doing?" — and family far away stays in the loop without the notification flood.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
A care profile with conditions, allergies and the care team, plus an emergency card you can show any doctor or EMT. Premium adds a shared vault for insurance cards, discharge papers and legal documents.

ROLES THAT KEEP THINGS CALM
Organisers run the care circle, caregivers handle the day-to-day, and viewers stay informed without a notification for every dose.

Built for elder care, dementia and Alzheimer's care, recovery after a hospital stay, or anyone who needs a hand — and the family members sharing that work.

FREE TRIAL AND PREMIUM
New accounts get 3 days free to try Care Nest — no card needed. After the trial a subscription is required to keep using the app.

Premium unlocks unlimited medications and circle members, AI label scanning, and the shared document vault. One subscription covers everyone, so the rest of your circle joins free.
